title: AffidavitField
description: One sworn field inside an affidavit: the proposed value, the value it replaces, and the full provenance chain behind it.

name.description: The field's name on the target entity. Also the key used by the amendment maps.

value.description: The proposed value. Any JSON value, including null — the .NET model types this as a nullable object, so no type constraint applies.

previousValue.description: The value being replaced. Any JSON value, including null; null for a create operation, and also for a field that had no previous value.

isMandatory.description: Whether the target entity requires this field.

kind.description: Rendering hint for a reviewer surface. A plain string on the wire, not a serialized enum, but drawn from a fixed set defined once in the framework.

allowedValues.description: The closed set a reviewer may pick from when kind is "enum"; null otherwise.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must satisfy, or null when the field is unconstrained.
